title: GloBE Article 9.1 Transition Deferred Tax Tracker
description: Recomputes the OECD GloBE Article 9.1 transition recast of pre-regime deferred tax attributes for one jurisdiction, item by item over a bounded array, and reports the jurisdictional roll-forward total. Article 9.1.1's lower-of rule is applied as a cap, so an attribute already recorded at or below the lower of the Minimum Rate and the applicable domestic tax rate is left where it is; the one path on which a recast rises is Article 9.1.1's third sentence, where a deferred tax asset recorded below the Minimum Rate is taken at the Minimum Rate on a caller-declared GloBE Loss demonstration. Article 9.1.2 exclusions apply only where a declared limb holds and the attribute arose strictly after the cut off, each reported with a named code and contributing exactly zero rather than being dropped. Article 9.1.3 recasts a qualifying intra group transfer on the disposing entity's carrying value. Rates, the cut off date, the Transition Year start and the exclusion set are versioned policy parameters, never kernel constants. Verify only: characterization, the GloBE Loss demonstration and the separate Grace Period determination all stay with the filer.

constants_version.description: Rule vintage label for the parameter set below. A guidance change is a version bump, never a silent recompute.

minimum_rate.description: The GloBE Minimum Rate as a decimal (0.15 = 15%), supplied as a versioned policy parameter. Never a kernel constant.

cutoff_date.description: Article 9.1.2 and 9.1.3 boundary date, YYYY-MM-DD. The comparison is strictly after, so an attribute arising on this date is not past the boundary.

transition_year_start_date.description: First day of the Transition Year for the jurisdiction, YYYY-MM-DD. Required to evaluate Article 9.1.3's window; its absence is a named error on any item declaring an intra group transfer.

exclusion_rules.description: The versioned exclusion set: named codes drawn from EXCL_NOT_REFLECTABLE_UNDER_AFAS, EXCL_CH3_ITEM_POST_CUTOFF, EXCL_GOVERNMENTAL_ARRANGEMENT_POST_CUTOFF, EXCL_RETROACTIVE_ELECTION_POST_CUTOFF and EXCL_NEW_CIT_BASIS_STEP_UP_POST_CUTOFF. A code outside this set is a named error.

items.description: Deferred tax attributes, at most 500 (MAX_DTA_ITEMS, a declared kernel constant). An over length array is a named error, never a longer loop or a silent truncation. Each item: {attribute_type, carrying_amount, recorded_at_rate, domestic_tax_rate, arising_date, arises_from_chapter3_excluded_item, arises_from_governmental_arrangement, arises_from_retroactive_election, arises_from_new_cit_basis_step_up, reflectable_under_authorised_accounting_standard, arises_from_intra_group_transfer, disposing_entity_carrying_value?, globe_loss_demonstrated?, valuation_adjustment_reflected?, carrying_amount_gross_of_valuation_adjustment?, arises_under_newly_enacted_cit?}. attribute_type is the closed enum deferred_tax_asset, deferred_tax_asset_from_globe_loss, deferred_tax_liability.

mcp_tool_definition.name: track_globe_transition_deferred_tax
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes the GloBE Article 9.1 transition recast per deferred tax attribute and the jurisdictional roll-forward total, applying the lower-of rate as a cap, the Article 9.1.1 GloBE Loss uplift only on a declared demonstration, named-code Article 9.1.2 exclusions keyed strictly after the cut off date, and the Article 9.1.3 disposing entity basis. Rates, dates and the exclusion set are versioned policy parameters.

output_example.canonical_order: arising_date asc, attribute_type asc, carrying_amount asc, input_index asc
output_example.note: Recomputes the Article 9.1 transition recast from caller-declared attributes and versioned policy parameters. Characterization and any GloBE-Loss demonstration stay with the filer. Grace Period treatment under Commentary 8.8-8.12 is a separate determination this node does not make.
